title: Do LLMs Know Your Neighborhood? Auditing LLM Priors for Neighborhood-Level Mobility Prediction and Structural Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Directional alignment analysis comparing LLM-implied directional effects of racial and ethnic population share predictors (e.g., Black, Asian, Hispanic/Latino) on mobility outcomes against empirical trends.
Directional alignment analysis comparing LLM-implied directional effects of median income predictors on mobility outcomes against empirical trends.
Directional alignment analysis comparing LLM-implied directional effects of age demographic predictors (e.g., Age 18-29, Age 55-64) on mobility outcomes against empirical trends.
